target_customer: Fish farms, hatcheries and seafood processors
problem: Fish handling decisions are made with little per-fish data and much work is manual.
business_model: Software subscription plus pilots, robotics later
product_category: Computer vision and robotics for aquaculture

founders.name: Paul Grech
education: Carnegie Mellon University, Robotics Institute Pathways Fellow

founders.name: Rohan Singh
education: Carnegie Mellon University, MS AI Engineering

competitors.name: Aquaticode
competitors.what: AI phenotyping and sorting for fish
competitors.traction_then: Agreements with Cooke Espana, Australis and AquaChile

technical_complexity.rationale: Wet, slippery, variable fish make vision and later robotic handling hard.

defensibility.rationale: Labeled multi-species images and breeding-family links compound, but hardware is off the shelf (Luxonis cameras).

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Few large players focused on hatchery inspection found.

market_need_then: A six-figure paid pilot with the largest trout producer in North America (company statement). Aquaculture is the fastest-growing food sector per the company.

branding.name_origin: Not stated. Likely a play on octa and pulse; unconfirmed.
branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN thread and YC launch post

brand_strength.rationale: Launch HN coverage exists, nothing else on the brand.

outcome_analysis: OctaPulse started with hatchery inspection and sells a paid trout pilot. It has no outcome yet. Founders combine robotics engineering with aquaculture industry roles, but funding figures only come from aggregators and the competitive set is thin.
notes: Aggregators (VCBacked, PitchBook, Caplight) report roughly $500K pre-seed in March 2026 from YC, Pioneer Fund and others; they disagree and no primary source, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Paul Grech listed non-technical by judgment from his Bloomberg sales role. Website fetch returned only the name. Completeness pass: one round recorded on the strength of a single database or outlet, VCBacked (a single database; Employbl shows the same figure). No primary announcement found.
